usage: jbus word [-h] (--to PROJECT | --all) [--by BY] [--at AT]
                 [--message THREAD/MESSAGE] [--from THREAD]
                 [words ...]

positional arguments:
  words                 the user's words, with --by and --at

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --to PROJECT          the project whose home it is for
  --all                 the home of every project
  --by BY               the user's name, with --at, for words that were typed
  --at AT               "<YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM ZONE>", the zone as jstack's config
                        words it
  --message THREAD/MESSAGE
                        the user's own message in T3 Code, in place of --by,
                        --at and the words
  --from THREAD         the thread running this: a word recorded by a
                        project's home is not posted to it
